high_level_description: The image is a meme featuring a person taking a selfie in what appears to be a bathroom, as indicated by the tiled wall in the background. The individual has long, straight hair with a light pink bow accessory on one side. They are wearing a sleeveless top with a checkered pattern in shades of white and pink. Around their neck, they have a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant. The person is holding a smartphone with a black case that has some text on it, though the text is not fully legible.
